label: Heavy bald man, grey vest, unhappy
prompt: A photorealistic still of a heavy-set, slouching man with a wide soft face, a pale bald crown ringed by thin grey stubble, deep lines from nose to mouth, loose jowls and tired, pouched eyes that are slightly bloodshot. He wears a washed-out grey cotton vest that sags at the neck and shows pink sunburnt shoulders and freckled forearms. He has stopped directly beneath a camera fixed high in the corner of a municipal gym and glanced up and back over his shoulder, his chin tilted up so the lens looks down on his scalp and brow, his expression flat and unhappy as he checks the room. Behind him are rubber floor tiles, a rack of chipped black dumbbells and a pale breeze-block wall. The only light is a flat, greenish strip light directly overhead that leaves shadow in his eye sockets and under his chin. The picture is soft, slightly smeared and low in contrast, with muted colour and fine digital noise, as if a cheap fixed camera had recorded it unattended. Entirely clean frame with no overlay, lettering or numerals of any kind. Thanks.

label: Thin wiry man, yellow moustache, fleece
prompt: A photorealistic still of a thin, sinewy man with a long narrow face, hollow cheeks, a sharp Adam's apple and a drooping moustache stained nicotine-yellow at the middle, a few fair eyebrow hairs, and watery pale-blue eyes with heavy bags. His thin hair is combed over in oily strands. He wears a bobbled navy fleece with a faded embroidered patch on the chest that is too blurred to read, zipped up to the throat. He has walked right up under a camera mounted near the ceiling of a gym and glanced up at it with a weary squint, one hand rubbing the back of his neck while he checks the room behind him. We see him from slightly above, steeply foreshortened, with his forehead large and his chin small. Behind him are mirrored panels smeared with fingerprints and a row of cross-trainers. A single fluorescent tube overhead gives a cold, uneven light and a window on the far side is blown out to white. The image is soft and washed out with coarse grain and slightly crushed shadows, the look of footage from an unattended wide-angle camera. No writing, symbols or graphics appear anywhere in the frame. Thanks.

label: Black man, greying beard, tracksuit top
prompt: A photorealistic still of a Black British man with a broad forehead, deep-set heavy-lidded eyes with dark, puffy undereyes, a full beard going grey in patches at the chin and cheeks, a grey-flecked close-cropped head and a slightly rounded, tired face with a scar through the left eyebrow. He wears a black polyester zip-up tracksuit top with its zip pulled halfway, over a crumpled white T-shirt. He has stopped just under a ceiling-corner camera in a community leisure-centre gym and tilted his head up to glance at it, his mouth slack and his gaze weary and watchful, one shoulder turned towards the door he has just checked. The view is from high above and a little to the side, so we see the crown of his head, the top of his nose and his beard. Behind him are blue exercise mats stacked against a wall, a dented water fountain and a scuffed double door. Light comes from a row of ceiling panels that flicker slightly and cast flat, shadowless illumination, with a cold bright window at the edge of the frame. The picture is slightly muddy and compressed, with dulled colour and visible grain, as from a fixed unattended camera. The frame is bare picture only: no text, numbers or interface graphics. Thanks.

label: Jowly man, broken nose, charity T-shirt
prompt: A photorealistic still of a soft-bodied man with heavy jowls, a thick neck, a nose that was broken once and sits crooked with a flattened bridge, small close-set brown eyes under a creased brow, a high receding hairline with wispy dark hair above the ears, and blotchy red cheeks with broken veins. He wears a faded, thin cotton T-shirt in washed-out orange from an old charity fun run, its printing cracked and illegible, stretched over his belly and with a small stain near the hem. He has walked underneath a camera bolted high in the corner of a gym and glanced up at it with a tired, sidelong look, mouth slightly open, one eyebrow lowered as he checks the room. We look down at him from above, so his forehead and receding hair dominate and his chin doubles. Behind him are a treadmill, a scuffed wall of peeling green paint and a stack of grubby yoga blocks. A hard overhead tube light puts dark shadows under his brow and nose, and a dirty skylight smears pale daylight across one side of the floor. The image is slightly soft and bleached with fine noise and flattened colour, as if captured by a fixed lens that nobody operates. Nothing is written or drawn over the picture: no characters, no marks, no interface. Thanks.
